========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Api\Controllers\AuthController.cs
========================================================================================================================

using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using BCrypt.Net;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Api.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IRefreshTokenRepository _refreshTokenRepository;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    public AuthController(IUserRepository userRepository, IRefreshTokenRepository refreshTokenRepository, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _userRepository = userRepository;
        _refreshTokenRepository = refreshTokenRepository;
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    [HttpPost("revoke")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Revoke([FromBody] RefreshRequestDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Token)) return BadRequest();
        if (_refreshTokenRepository == null) return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Refresh token repository not available" });

        var stored = await _refreshTokenRepository.GetByTokenAsync(dto.Token);
        if (stored == null) return NotFound();

        await _refreshTokenRepository.RevokeAsync(stored);
        return NoContent();
    }

    [Authorize]
    [HttpPost("logout")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Logout()
    {
        var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst(System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt.JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub)?.Value;
        if (!Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId)) return Unauthorized();

        if (_refreshTokenRepository == null) return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Refresh token repository not available" });

        await _refreshTokenRepository.RevokeAllForUserAsync(userId);
        return NoContent();
    }

    [HttpPost("register")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Register([FromBody] RegisterDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();
        // basic validation
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Password) || dto.Password.Length < 8)
            return BadRequest(new { message = "Password must be at least 8 characters." });

        var unique = await _userRepository.IsPhoneUniqueAsync(dto.Phone);
        if (!unique) return BadRequest(new { message = "Phone already registered" });

        var user = new Domain.Entities.User
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Phone = dto.Phone,
            Name = dto.Name,
            Role = dto.Role ?? "User",
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(dto.Password)
        };

        await _userRepository.AddAsync(user);
        // if repository does not save changes, ensure caller saves; our GenericRepository uses context and SaveChanges may be required.
        // Attempt to save via a minimal approach if repository exposes no SaveChanges: rely on unit of work not present — use context via cast if needed.

        var token = GenerateToken(user);
        // create refresh token
        var refresh = CreateRefreshToken(user.Id);
        if (_refreshTokenRepository != null)
        {
            await _refreshTokenRepository.AddAsync(refresh);
        }

        return Ok(new AuthResponseDto { Token = token, ExpiresInMinutes = _configuration.GetValue<int>("Jwt:ExpiresMinutes"), RefreshToken = refresh.Token });
    }

    [Authorize]
    [HttpPost("change-password")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ChangePassword([FromBody] ChangePasswordDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();

        var userIdClaim = User.FindFirst(System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt.JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub)?.Value;
        if (!Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId)) return Unauthorized();

        var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
        if (user == null) return NotFound();

        var verified = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(dto.OldPassword, user.PasswordHash);
        if (!verified) return BadRequest(new { message = "Old password is incorrect" });

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.NewPassword) || dto.NewPassword.Length < 8)
            return BadRequest(new { message = "New password must be at least 8 characters." });

        user.PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(dto.NewPassword);
        await _userRepository.UpdateAsync(user);

        // revoke existing refresh tokens for safety
        if (_refreshTokenRepository != null)
        {
            await _refreshTokenRepository.RevokeAllForUserAsync(user.Id);
        }

        return NoContent();
    }

    [HttpPost("refresh")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Refresh([FromBody] RefreshRequestDto dto)
    {
        // refresh using persistent refresh tokens
        if (dto == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Token)) return BadRequest();
        if (_refreshTokenRepository == null) return StatusCode(500, new { message = "Refresh token repository not available" });

        var stored = await _refreshTokenRepository.GetByTokenAsync(dto.Token);
        if (stored == null) return Unauthorized();
        if (stored.ExpiresAt < DateTime.UtcNow) return Unauthorized(new { message = "Refresh token expired" });

        var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(stored.UserId);
        if (user == null) return Unauthorized();

        // rotate refresh token
        stored.IsRevoked = true;
        var newRefresh = CreateRefreshToken(user.Id);
        stored.ReplacedByToken = newRefresh.Token;
        await _refreshTokenRepository.UpdateAsync(stored);
        await _refreshTokenRepository.AddAsync(newRefresh);

        var newAccess = GenerateToken(user);
        return Ok(new AuthResponseDto { Token = newAccess, ExpiresInMinutes = _configuration.GetValue<int>("Jwt:ExpiresMinutes"), RefreshToken = newRefresh.Token });
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();

        var user = await _userRepository.GetByPhoneAsync(dto.Phone);
        if (user == null) return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid credentials" });

        var verified = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(dto.Password, user.PasswordHash);
        if (!verified) return Unauthorized(new { message = "Invalid credentials" });

        var token = GenerateToken(user);
        // create refresh token
        var refresh = CreateRefreshToken(user.Id);
        if (_refreshTokenRepository != null)
        {
            await _refreshTokenRepository.AddAsync(refresh);
        }

        return Ok(new AuthResponseDto { Token = token, ExpiresInMinutes = _configuration.GetValue<int>("Jwt:ExpiresMinutes"), RefreshToken = refresh.Token });
    }

    private string GenerateToken(Domain.Entities.User user)
    {
        var jwtSection = _configuration.GetSection("Jwt");
        var key = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Key");
        var issuer = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Issuer");
        var audience = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Audience");
        var expires = jwtSection.GetValue<int>("ExpiresMinutes");

        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName, user.Phone),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.Role ?? string.Empty)
        };

        var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key);
        var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(claims),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(expires > 0 ? expires : 60),
            Issuer = issuer,
            Audience = audience,
            SigningCredentials = new SigningCredentials(new SymmetricSecurityKey(keyBytes), SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256Signature)
        };

        var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
        var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);
        return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
    }

    private RefreshToken CreateRefreshToken(Guid userId)
    {
        var random = new byte[64];
        using var rng = System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(random);
        var token = Convert.ToBase64String(random);

        var expiresDays = _configuration.GetValue<int>("Jwt:RefreshExpiresDays", 7);

        return new RefreshToken
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = userId,
            Token = token,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(expiresDays),
            IsRevoked = false
        };
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Api\Controllers\CourseEpisodesController.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/courses/{courseId}/episodes")]
    public class CourseEpisodesController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ICourseEpisodeService _episodeService;
        public CourseEpisodesController(ICourseEpisodeService episodeService)
        {
            _episodeService = episodeService;
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,Instructor")]
        [RequestSizeLimit(2_000_000_000)] // 2GB ????
        public async Task<IActionResult> UploadEpisode(Guid courseId, [FromForm] CourseEpisodeUploadDto dto)
        {
            var result = await _episodeService.CreateAndUploadAsync(courseId, dto);
            return Ok(result);
        }

        [HttpGet("{episodeId}/status")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetStatus(Guid episodeId)
        {
            var status = await _episodeService.GetProcessingStatusAsync(episodeId);
            return Ok(status);
        }

        [HttpGet("{episodeId}/stream/{**path}")]
        [Authorize] // ?? ?????? ????? ?? ????
        public async Task<IActionResult> StreamHls(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string path)
        {
            // ??: ??? ????? ??? ???? ?? ?????? ?? IsFree ????
            var hasAccess = await _episodeService.UserHasAccessAsync(User, courseId, episodeId);
            if (!hasAccess) return Forbid();

            var fullPath = await _episodeService.ResolveHlsFilePathAsync(courseId, episodeId, path);
            if (!System.IO.File.Exists(fullPath)) return NotFound();

            var contentType = path.EndsWith(".m3u8") ? "application/vnd.apple.mpegurl" : "video/MP2T";
            return PhysicalFile(fullPath, contentType);
        }
    }

}




========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Api\Controllers\CoursesController.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class CoursesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ICourseService _courseService;

    public CoursesController(ICourseService courseService)
    {
        _courseService = courseService;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<CourseDto>>> GetAll()
    {
        var courses = await _courseService.GetAllAsync();
        return Ok(courses);
    }

    [HttpGet("published")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<CourseDto>>> GetPublished()
    {
        var courses = await _courseService.GetPublishedAsync();
        return Ok(courses);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<CourseDto>> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var course = await _courseService.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (course == null) return NotFound();
        return Ok(course);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<CourseDto>> Create([FromBody] CourseCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();
        var created = await _courseService.CreateAsync(dto);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = created.Id }, created);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class OrdersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IOrderService _orderService;

    public OrdersController(IOrderService orderService)
    {
        _orderService = orderService;
    }

    [HttpGet("user/{userId:guid}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<OrderDto>>> GetByUser(Guid userId)
    {
        var orders = await _orderService.GetOrdersByUserAsync(userId);
        return Ok(orders);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<OrderDto>> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var order = await _orderService.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (order == null) return NotFound();
        return Ok(order);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<OrderDto>> Create([FromBody] OrderCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();
        var created = await _orderService.CreateAsync(dto);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = created.Id }, created);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class PortfolioController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IPortfolioService _service;

    public PortfolioController(IPortfolioService service)
    {
        _service = service;
    }

    [HttpGet("published")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<PortfolioItemDto>>> GetPublished()
    {
        var items = await _service.GetPublishedAsync();
        return Ok(items);
    }

    [HttpGet("category/{category}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<PortfolioItemDto>>> GetByCategory(string category)
    {
        var items = await _service.GetByCategoryAsync(category);
        return Ok(items);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PortfolioItemDto>> Create([FromBody] PortfolioCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();
        var created = await _service.CreateAsync(dto);
        return CreatedAtAction(null, created);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Handicraft.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class UsersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IUserService _userService;

    public UsersController(IUserService userService)
    {
        _userService = userService;
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserDto>> Get(Guid id)
    {
        var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (user == null) return NotFound();
        return Ok(user);
    }

    [HttpGet("by-phone/{phone}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserDto>> GetByPhone(string phone)
    {
        var user = await _userService.GetByPhoneAsync(phone);
        if (user == null) return NotFound();
        return Ok(user);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserDto>> Create([FromBody] UserCreateDto dto)
    {
        if (dto == null) return BadRequest();

        var created = await _userService.CreateAsync(dto);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = created.Id }, created);
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Api\Models\AuthResponseDto.cs

namespace Handicraft.Api.Models;

public class AuthResponseDto
{
    public string Token { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int ExpiresInMinutes { get; set; }
    public string? RefreshToken { get; set; }
}

========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Api\Program.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Handicraft.Application.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.BackgroundServices;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Services;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Read JWT settings
var jwtSection = builder.Configuration.GetSection("Jwt");
var jwtKey = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Key") ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Key is not configured");
var jwtIssuer = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Issuer") ?? "Handicraft";
var jwtAudience = jwtSection.GetValue<string>("Audience") ?? "HandicraftUsers";
var jwtExpiresMinutes = jwtSection.GetValue<int>("ExpiresMinutes");

// Add DbContext with PostgreSQL
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Repository registrations
builder.Services.AddScoped<IUserRepository, UserRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IRefreshTokenRepository, RefreshTokenRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseRepository, CourseRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseEpisodeRepository, CourseEpisodeRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseEnrollmentRepository, CourseEnrollmentRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IUserDeviceRepository, UserDeviceRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IPortfolioItemRepository, PortfolioItemRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IOrderRepository, OrderRepository>();

// AutoMapper
builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(Handicraft.Application.Services.MappingProfile).Assembly);

// Application services
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseService, CourseService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IUserService, UserService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IOrderService, OrderService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IPortfolioService, PortfolioService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IUserDeviceService, UserDeviceService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseEnrollmentService, CourseEnrollmentService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICourseEpisodeService, CourseEpisodeService>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<VideoProcessingBackgroundService>();
// Video processing services
builder.Services.AddScoped<IVideoStorageService, LocalVideoStorageService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IVideoProcessor, FfmpegVideoProcessor>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<VideoProcessingBackgroundService>();



// Add Controllers
builder.Services.AddControllers();

// Authentication - JWT Bearer
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
{
    options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
    options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
})
.AddJwtBearer(options =>
{
    options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
    {
        ValidateIssuer = true,
        ValidateAudience = true,
        ValidateLifetime = true,
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
        ValidIssuer = jwtIssuer,
        ValidAudience = jwtAudience,
        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtKey))
    };
});

// Swagger
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new() { Title = "Handicraft API", Version = "v1" });
    // JWT Bearer token support in Swagger
    c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
    {
        Description = "Enter 'Bearer' [space] and then your valid token in the text input below.\r\n\r\nExample: 'Bearer eyJhb...'",
        Name = "Authorization",
        In = ParameterLocation.Header,
        Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
        Scheme = "bearer",
        BearerFormat = "JWT"
    });

    c.AddSecurityRequirement(new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
    {
        {
            new OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Reference = new OpenApiReference { Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme, Id = "Bearer" }
            },
            new string[] { }
        }
    });
});

var app = builder.Build();

// Apply migrations and seed data only in Development
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
    {
        var services = scope.ServiceProvider;
        try
        {
            var db = services.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
            db.Database.Migrate();
            await DataSeeder.SeedAsync(db);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            var logger = services.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();
            logger.LogError(ex, "An error occurred while migrating or seeding the database.");
            throw;
        }
    }
}

// Enable Swagger and Swagger UI in all environments
app.UseSwagger();
app.UseSwaggerUI(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "Handicraft API V1");
});

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();

      "applicationUrl": "https://localhost:7222;http://localhost:5182",
      "environmentVariables": {
        "ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT": "Development"
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Application.Tests\Tests\CourseEnrollmentServiceTests.cs
========================================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AutoMapper;
using Handicraft.Application.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Tests.Tests;

public class CourseEnrollmentServiceTests
{
    private IMapper CreateMapper()
    {
        var config = new MapperConfiguration(cfg => cfg.AddProfile<Handicraft.Application.Services.MappingProfile>());
        return config.CreateMapper();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync_ReturnsMapped()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<ICourseEnrollmentRepository>();
        var items = new List<CourseEnrollment>
        {
            new CourseEnrollment { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserId = Guid.NewGuid(), CourseId = Guid.NewGuid(), PaidAmount = 10, EnrolledAt = DateTime.UtcNow, IsActive = true, CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }
        };
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>())).ReturnsAsync(items);

        var svc = new CourseEnrollmentService(mockRepo.Object, CreateMapper());
        var res = await svc.GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync(Guid.NewGuid());
        Assert.Single(res);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateAsync_CreatesAndReturns()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<ICourseEnrollmentRepository>();
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<CourseEnrollment>())).ReturnsAsync((CourseEnrollment e) => e);

        var svc = new CourseEnrollmentService(mockRepo.Object, CreateMapper());
        var create = new CourseEnrollmentCreateDto(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid(), 20m, null);
        var created = await svc.CreateAsync(create);
        Assert.Equal(create.PaidAmount, created.PaidAmount);
        mockRepo.Verify(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<CourseEnrollment>()), Times.Once);
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Application.Tests\Tests\CourseServiceTests.cs
========================================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Handicraft.Application.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Tests.Tests;

public class CourseServiceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task GetAllAsync_Returns_MappedDtos()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<ICourseRepository>();
        var courses = new List<Course>
        {
            new Course { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Title = "C1", Description = "D1", Price = 10, CoverImageUrl = "u", IsPublished = true, DurationMinutes = 60 }
        };
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetAllWithEpisodesAsync()).ReturnsAsync(courses);

        var svc = new CourseService(mockRepo.Object);

        var result = await svc.GetAllAsync();

        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Collection(result, c => Assert.Equal("C1", c.Title));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateAsync_Calls_Repository_And_ReturnsDto()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<ICourseRepository>();
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<Course>())).ReturnsAsync((Course c) => c);

        var svc = new CourseService(mockRepo.Object);

        var dto = new CourseCreateDto("T","Desc","img",9.99m,false,100,null);
        var created = await svc.CreateAsync(dto);

        Assert.Equal(dto.Title, created.Title);
        mockRepo.Verify(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<Course>()), Times.Once);
    }
}

        var mockRepo = new Mock<IOrderRepository>();
        var orders = new List<Order>
        {
            new Order { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), UserId = Guid.NewGuid(), Type = "T", Description = "D", Status = "New", CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }

        Assert.Single(res);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateAsync_CallsRepo()

    }

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using AutoMapper;
using Handicraft.Application.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Tests.Tests;

public class UserServiceTests
{
    private IMapper CreateMapper()
    {
        var config = new MapperConfiguration(cfg => cfg.AddProfile<Handicraft.Application.Services.MappingProfile>());
        return config.CreateMapper();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetByPhoneAsync_ReturnsMappedDto()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<IUserRepository>();
        var user = new User { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Phone = "09120000000", Name = "Saman", Role = "Admin", PasswordHash = "h" };
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetByPhoneAsync(user.Phone)).ReturnsAsync(user);

        var mapper = CreateMapper();
        var svc = new UserService(mockRepo.Object, mapper);

        var dto = await svc.GetByPhoneAsync(user.Phone);
        Assert.NotNull(dto);
        Assert.Equal(user.Phone, dto.Phone);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateAsync_CreatesAndReturnsDto()
    {
        var mockRepo = new Mock<IUserRepository>();
        mockRepo.Setup(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<User>())).ReturnsAsync((User u) => u);

        var mapper = CreateMapper();
        var svc = new UserService(mockRepo.Object, mapper);

        var create = new UserCreateDto("09121112222", "Saman", "hash", "User", true);
        var created = await svc.CreateAsync(create);

        Assert.Equal(create.Phone, created.Phone);
        mockRepo.Verify(r => r.AddAsync(It.IsAny<User>()), Times.Once);
    }
}

using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;

public interface IGenericRepository<T> where T : class
{
    Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id);
    Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAllAsync();
    Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate);
    Task<T> AddAsync(T entity);
    Task UpdateAsync(T entity);
    Task DeleteAsync(T entity);
    Task<bool> ExistsAsync(Guid id);
}

namespace Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;

public interface IVideoStorageService
{
    Task<string> SaveRawVideoAsync(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, Stream fileStream, string fileName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    string GetRawVideoPath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string fileName);
    string GetHlsOutputDirectory(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId);
    string GetHlsPhysicalFilePath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string relativePath);
    string GetHlsPlaylistPath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId);
    Task DeleteEpisodeFilesAsync(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId);
}

using AutoMapper;
using AutoMapper;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Services;

public class CourseEnrollmentService : ICourseEnrollmentService
{
    private readonly ICourseEnrollmentRepository _repo;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public CourseEnrollmentService(ICourseEnrollmentRepository repo, IMapper mapper)
    {
        _repo = repo;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseEnrollmentDto>> GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var items = await _repo.GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync(userId);
        return items.Select(i => _mapper.Map<CourseEnrollmentDto>(i)).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseEnrollmentDto>> GetEnrollmentsByCourseAsync(Guid courseId)
    {
        var items = await _repo.GetEnrollmentsByCourseAsync(courseId);
        return items.Select(i => _mapper.Map<CourseEnrollmentDto>(i)).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<CourseEnrollmentDto> CreateAsync(CourseEnrollmentCreateDto dto)
    {
        var e = _mapper.Map<CourseEnrollment>(dto);
        e.EnrolledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        e.Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        var created = await _repo.AddAsync(e);
        return _mapper.Map<CourseEnrollmentDto>(created);
    }
}




========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Application\Services\CourseEpisodeService.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence; // namespace ????
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Services;

public class CourseEpisodeService : ICourseEpisodeService
{
    private readonly ICourseEpisodeRepository _episodeRepository;
    private readonly IVideoStorageService _videoStorage;

    public CourseEpisodeService(
        ICourseEpisodeRepository episodeRepository,
        IVideoStorageService videoStorage)
    {
        _episodeRepository = episodeRepository;
        _videoStorage = videoStorage;
    }

    public async Task<CourseEpisodeDto> CreateAndUploadAsync(Guid courseId, CourseEpisodeUploadDto dto)
    {
        var episode = new CourseEpisode
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(), // ??? BaseEntity ??? ?? ????
            CourseId = courseId,
            Title = dto.Title,
            Description = dto.Description,
            Order = dto.Order,
            IsFree = dto.IsFree,
            Status = VideoProcessingStatus.Pending
        };

        await using var stream = dto.VideoFile.OpenReadStream();
        await _videoStorage.SaveRawVideoAsync(
            courseId, episode.Id, stream, dto.VideoFile.FileName);

        episode.RawVideoFileName = dto.VideoFile.FileName;



        var created = await _episodeRepository.AddAsync(episode);

        return MapToDto(created);
    }

    public async Task<CourseEpisodeDto?> GetProcessingStatusAsync(Guid episodeId)
    {
        var episode = await _episodeRepository.GetByIdAsync(episodeId);
        return episode is null ? null : MapToDto(episode);
    }

    public async Task<bool> UserHasAccessAsync(ClaimsPrincipal user, Guid courseId, Guid episodeId)
    {
        var episode = await _episodeRepository.GetByIdAsync(episodeId);
        if (episode is null) return false;
        if (episode.IsFree) return true;

        // TODO: ?? enrollment ????? ????? - ???? ?? ICourseEnrollmentRepository
        return false;
    }

    public async Task<string?> ResolveHlsFilePathAsync(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string relativePath)
    {
        var episode = await _episodeRepository.GetByIdAsync(episodeId);
        if (episode is null || episode.Status != VideoProcessingStatus.Ready) return null;

        var hlsFolder = Path.GetDirectoryName(
            _videoStorage.GetHlsPlaylistPath(courseId, episodeId)) ?? string.Empty;

        return Path.Combine(hlsFolder, relativePath);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CourseEpisodeDto>> GetEpisodesByCourseIdAsync(Guid courseId)
    {
        var episodes = await _episodeRepository.GetEpisodesByCourseIdAsync(courseId);
        return episodes.Select(MapToDto).ToList();
    }

    private static CourseEpisodeDto MapToDto(CourseEpisode e) => new(
        e.Id,
        e.Title,
        e.Description,
        e.VideoUrl,
        e.Order,
        e.DurationSeconds,
        e.IsFree
    );
}




========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Application\Services\CourseService.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Services;

public class CourseService : ICourseService
{
    private readonly ICourseRepository _courseRepository;

    public CourseService(ICourseRepository courseRepository)
    {
        _courseRepository = courseRepository;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseDto>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var courses = await _courseRepository.GetAllWithEpisodesAsync();
        return courses.Select(MapToDto).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseDto>> GetPublishedAsync()
    {
        var courses = await _courseRepository.GetPublishedCoursesAsync();
        return courses.Select(MapToDto).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<CourseDto?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var course = await _courseRepository.GetByIdWithEpisodesAsync(id);
        if (course == null) return null;
        return MapToDto(course);
    }

    public async Task<CourseDto> CreateAsync(CourseCreateDto dto)
    {
        var course = new Course
        {
            Title = dto.Title,
            Description = dto.Description,
            CoverImageUrl = dto.CoverImageUrl,
            Price = dto.Price,
            IsPublished = dto.IsPublished,
            DurationMinutes = dto.DurationMinutes
        };

        if (dto.Episodes != null && dto.Episodes.Any())
        {
            foreach (var ep in dto.Episodes)
            {
                course.Episodes.Add(new CourseEpisode
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    Title = ep.Title,
                    Description = ep.Description,
                    VideoUrl = ep.VideoUrl,
                    Order = ep.Order,
                    DurationSeconds = ep.DurationSeconds,
                    IsFree = ep.IsFree,
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }

        var created = await _courseRepository.AddAsync(course);
        return MapToDto(created);
    }

    private static CourseDto MapToDto(Course c)
    {
        var episodes = c.Episodes?.OrderBy(e => e.Order).Select(e => new Dtos.CourseEpisodeDto(
            e.Id,
            e.Title,
            e.Description,
            e.VideoUrl,
            e.Order,
            e.DurationSeconds,
            e.IsFree
        )).ToList() ?? new List<CourseEpisodeDto>();

        return new CourseDto(
            c.Id,
            c.Title,
            c.Description,
            c.CoverImageUrl,
            c.Price,
            c.IsPublished,
            c.DurationMinutes,
            episodes
        );
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Application\Services\MappingProfile.cs
========================================================================================================================

using AutoMapper;
using Handicraft.Application.Services.Dtos;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Services;

public class MappingProfile : Profile
{
    public MappingProfile()
    {
        // Course
        CreateMap<Course, CourseDto>();
        CreateMap<CourseEpisode, CourseEpisodeDto>();
        CreateMap<CourseCreateDto, Course>();
        CreateMap<CourseEpisodeCreateDto, CourseEpisode>();

        // User
        CreateMap<User, UserDto>();
        CreateMap<UserCreateDto, User>();

        // Order
        CreateMap<Order, OrderDto>();
        CreateMap<OrderCreateDto, Order>();

        // Portfolio
        CreateMap<PortfolioItem, PortfolioItemDto>();
        CreateMap<PortfolioCreateDto, PortfolioItem>();

        // UserDevice
        CreateMap<UserDevice, UserDeviceDto>();
        CreateMap<UserDeviceCreateDto, UserDevice>();

        // CourseEnrollment
        CreateMap<CourseEnrollment, CourseEnrollmentDto>();
        CreateMap<CourseEnrollmentCreateDto, CourseEnrollment>();
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\BackgroundServices\VideoProcessingBackgroundService.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Handicraft.Application.Services;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.BackgroundServices;

public class VideoProcessingBackgroundService : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<VideoProcessingBackgroundService> _logger;

    public VideoProcessingBackgroundService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        ILogger<VideoProcessingBackgroundService> logger)
    {
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
                var episodeRepo = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<ICourseEpisodeRepository>();
                var storage = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<IVideoStorageService>();
                var processor = scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<IVideoProcessor>();

                var pendingEpisodes = await episodeRepo.GetAsync(
                    e => e.Status == VideoProcessingStatus.Pending);

                foreach (var episode in pendingEpisodes)
                {
                    episode.Status = VideoProcessingStatus.Processing;
                    await episodeRepo.UpdateAsync(episode);

                    try
                    {
                        var rawPath = storage.GetRawVideoPath(
                            episode.CourseId, episode.Id, episode.RawVideoFileName!);

                        var hlsOutputDir = storage.GetHlsOutputDirectory(
                            episode.CourseId, episode.Id);

                        var (masterPlaylistRelativePath, durationSeconds) =
                            await processor.ConvertToHlsAsync(rawPath, hlsOutputDir, stoppingToken);

                        episode.VideoUrl = masterPlaylistRelativePath;
                        episode.DurationSeconds = durationSeconds;
                        episode.Status = VideoProcessingStatus.Ready;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to process episode {EpisodeId}", episode.Id);
                        episode.Status = VideoProcessingStatus.Failed;
                    }

                    await episodeRepo.UpdateAsync(episode);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error in VideoProcessingBackgroundService loop");
            }

            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), stoppingToken);
        }
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Persistence\Data\AppDbContext.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Course> Courses => Set<Course>();
    public DbSet<CourseEpisode> CourseEpisodes => Set<CourseEpisode>();
    public DbSet<CourseEnrollment> CourseEnrollments => Set<CourseEnrollment>();
    public DbSet<PortfolioItem> PortfolioItems => Set<PortfolioItem>();
    public DbSet<Order> Orders => Set<Order>();
    public DbSet<UserDevice> UserDevices => Set<UserDevice>();
    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // User
        modelBuilder.Entity<User>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("Users");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Phone).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(15);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Phone).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(e => e.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
            entity.Property(e => e.PasswordHash).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.Role).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(20);
            entity.Property(e => e.IsActive).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();
        });

        // Course
        modelBuilder.Entity<Course>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("Courses");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Title).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
            entity.Property(e => e.Description).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(2000);
            entity.Property(e => e.CoverImageUrl).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.Price).HasColumnType("decimal(18,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.IsPublished).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.DurationMinutes).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();
        });

        // CourseEpisode
        modelBuilder.Entity<CourseEpisode>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("CourseEpisodes");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Title).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
            entity.Property(e => e.Description).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(1000);
            entity.Property(e => e.VideoUrl).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.Order).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.DurationSeconds).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.IsFree).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.Course)
                .WithMany(c => c.Episodes)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.CourseId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // CourseEnrollment
        modelBuilder.Entity<CourseEnrollment>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("CourseEnrollments");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.PaidAmount).HasColumnType("decimal(18,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.EnrolledAt).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.IsActive).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.Enrollments)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasOne(e => e.Course)
                .WithMany(c => c.Enrollments)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.CourseId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.UserId, e.CourseId });
        });

        // PortfolioItem
        modelBuilder.Entity<PortfolioItem>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("PortfolioItems");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Title).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
            entity.Property(e => e.Category).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
            entity.Property(e => e.ImageUrl).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.Description).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(1000);
            entity.Property(e => e.IsVisible).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();
        });

        // Order
        modelBuilder.Entity<Order>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("Orders");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Type).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
            entity.Property(e => e.Description).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(2000);
            entity.Property(e => e.ImageUrl).HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.Status).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
            entity.Property(e => e.EstimatedPrice).HasColumnType("decimal(18,2)");
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.Orders)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // UserDevice
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserDevice>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("UserDevices");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.DeviceId).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
            entity.Property(e => e.DeviceName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
            entity.Property(e => e.IpAddress).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(50);
            entity.Property(e => e.LastSeenAt).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.IsActive).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.Devices)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.UserId, e.DeviceId });
        });

        // RefreshToken
        modelBuilder.Entity<RefreshToken>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("RefreshTokens");
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.Token).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
            entity.Property(e => e.ExpiresAt).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.IsRevoked).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).IsRequired();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.RefreshTokens)
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Token).IsUnique();
        });
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Persistence\Data\DataSeeder.cs

using BCrypt.Net;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;

public static class DataSeeder
{
    public static async Task SeedAsync(AppDbContext context)
    {
        // Ensure DB created (migrations should be applied by caller)

        // Seed roles and admin user if not exists
        if (!context.Users.Any(u => u.Role == "Admin"))
        {
            var admin = new User
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Phone = "09120000000",
                Name = "Admin",
                Role = "Admin",
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword("Admin123!") // change in production
            };

            await context.Users.AddAsync(admin);
            await context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}




========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Repositories\CourseEnrollmentRepository.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CourseEnrollmentRepository : GenericRepository<CourseEnrollment>, ICourseEnrollmentRepository
{
    public CourseEnrollmentRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    // Interface implementation: returns IEnumerable as declared in ICourseEnrollmentRepository
    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseEnrollment>> GetEnrollmentsByUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEnrollments
            .Include(e => e.Course)
            .Where(e => e.UserId == userId)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    // Interface implementation: get enrollments for a specific course
    public async Task<IEnumerable<CourseEnrollment>> GetEnrollmentsByCourseAsync(Guid courseId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEnrollments
            .Include(e => e.User)
            .Where(e => e.CourseId == courseId)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    // Additional convenience method (kept) — returns single enrollment if exists
    public async Task<CourseEnrollment?> GetEnrollmentAsync(Guid userId, Guid courseId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEnrollments
            .Include(e => e.Course)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.UserId == userId && e.CourseId == courseId);
    }

    // Check if a user is enrolled in a course
    public async Task<bool> IsUserEnrolledAsync(Guid userId, Guid courseId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEnrollments
            .AnyAsync(e => e.UserId == userId && e.CourseId == courseId);
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Repositories\CourseEpisodeRepository.cs

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CourseEpisodeRepository : GenericRepository<CourseEpisode>, ICourseEpisodeRepository
{
    public CourseEpisodeRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CourseEpisode>> GetEpisodesByCourseIdAsync(Guid courseId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEpisodes
            .Where(e => e.CourseId == courseId)
            .OrderBy(e => e.Order)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<CourseEpisode?> GetEpisodeByOrderAsync(Guid courseId, int order)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEpisodes
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.CourseId == courseId && e.Order == order);
    }

    public async Task<CourseEpisode?> GetEpisodeWithCourseAsync(Guid episodeId)
    {
        return await _context.CourseEpisodes
            .Include(e => e.Course)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == episodeId);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CourseRepository : GenericRepository<Course>, ICourseRepository
{
    public CourseRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Course>> GetAllWithEpisodesAsync()
    {
        return await _context.Courses
            .Include(c => c.Episodes)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<Course?> GetByIdWithEpisodesAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.Courses
            .Include(c => c.Episodes)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == id);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Course>> GetPublishedCoursesAsync()
    {
        return await _context.Courses
            .Include(c => c.Episodes)
            .Where(c => c.Episodes.Any())
            .ToListAsync();
    }
}




========================================================================================================================
FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Repositories\GenericRepository.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class GenericRepository<T> : IGenericRepository<T> where T : class
{
    protected readonly AppDbContext _context;

    public GenericRepository(AppDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.Set<T>().FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        return await _context.Set<T>().ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate)
    {
        return await _context.Set<T>().Where(predicate).ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<T> AddAsync(T entity)
    {
        await _context.Set<T>().AddAsync(entity);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        return entity;
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(T entity)
    {
        _context.Entry(entity).State = EntityState.Modified;
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(T entity)
    {
        _context.Set<T>().Remove(entity);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var entity = await GetByIdAsync(id);
        return entity != null;
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Repositories\OrderRepository.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class OrderRepository : GenericRepository<Order>, IOrderRepository
{
    public OrderRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Order>> GetOrdersByUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        return await _context.Orders
            .Where(o => o.UserId == userId)     
            .OrderByDescending(o => o.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<Order?> GetOrderWithItemsAsync(Guid orderId)
    {
        // The current Order entity does not contain order items in the domain model.
        // Include related User for completeness so callers can access the customer if needed.
        return await _context.Orders
            .Include(o => o.User)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == orderId);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;

using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class PortfolioItemRepository : GenericRepository<PortfolioItem>, IPortfolioItemRepository
{
    public PortfolioItemRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PortfolioItem>> GetPublishedItemsAsync()
    {
        // The domain uses `IsVisible` for visibility of portfolio items.
        return await _context.PortfolioItems
            .Where(p => p.IsVisible)
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PortfolioItem>> GetItemsByCategoryAsync(string category)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category))
            return Array.Empty<PortfolioItem>();

        return await _context.PortfolioItems
            .Where(p => p.IsVisible && p.Category.ToLower() == category.Trim().ToLower())
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Repositories\RefreshTokenRepository.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class RefreshTokenRepository : GenericRepository<RefreshToken>, IRefreshTokenRepository
{
    public RefreshTokenRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<RefreshToken?> GetByTokenAsync(string token)
    {
        return await _context.RefreshTokens.FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Token == token && !t.IsRevoked);
    }

    public async Task RevokeAsync(RefreshToken token)
    {
        token.IsRevoked = true;
        await UpdateAsync(token);
    }

    public async Task RevokeAllForUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var tokens = await _context.RefreshTokens.Where(t => t.UserId == userId && !t.IsRevoked).ToListAsync();
        foreach (var t in tokens) t.IsRevoked = true;
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class UserDeviceRepository : GenericRepository<UserDevice>, IUserDeviceRepository
{
    public UserDeviceRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<UserDevice>> GetDevicesByUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        return await _context.UserDevices
            .Where(d => d.UserId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(d => d.LastSeenAt)
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<UserDevice?> GetDeviceByTokenAsync(string deviceToken)
    {
        // The domain stores a `DeviceId` field (token/unique id). Match that here.
        return await _context.UserDevices
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.DeviceId == deviceToken);
    }

    public async Task<int> GetActiveDeviceCountAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        return await _context.UserDevices
            .CountAsync(d => d.UserId == userId && d.IsActive);
    }

    // Keep existing convenience method (name changed to match domain) if callers need it
    public async Task<bool> IsDeviceRegisteredAsync(Guid userId, string deviceId)
    {
        return await _context.UserDevices
            .AnyAsync(d => d.UserId == userId && d.DeviceId == deviceId);
    }
}

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
using Handicraft.Domain.Entities;
using Handicraft.Infrastructure.Persistence.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class UserRepository : GenericRepository<User>, IUserRepository
{
    public UserRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context)
    {
    }

    public async Task<User?> GetByPhoneAsync(string phone)
    {
        return await _context.Users
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Phone == phone);
    }

    public async Task<bool> IsPhoneUniqueAsync(string phone)
    {
        return !await _context.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Phone == phone);
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Services\FfmpegVideoProcessor.cs
========================================================================================================================

using System.Diagnostics;
using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;

namespace Handicraft.Infrastructure.Services;

public class FfmpegVideoProcessor : IVideoProcessor
{
    public async Task<VideoConversionResult> ConvertToHlsAsync(string inputFilePath, string outputDirectory, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);

        var masterPlaylistPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, "master.m3u8");

        var ffmpegArgs =
            $"-i \"{inputFilePath}\" " +
            "-filter_complex \"[0:v]split=3[v1][v2][v3];" +
            "[v1]scale=w=640:h=360[v1out];[v2]scale=w=854:h=480[v2out];[v3]scale=w=1280:h=720[v3out]\" " +
            "-map [v1out] -c:v:0 libx264 -b:v:0 800k " +
            "-map [v2out] -c:v:1 libx264 -b:v:1 1400k " +
            "-map [v3out] -c:v:2 libx264 -b:v:2 2800k " +
            "-map a:0? -map a:0? -map a:0? -c:a aac -b:a 128k " +
            "-var_stream_map \"v:0,a:0 v:1,a:1 v:2,a:2\" " +
            "-f hls -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod " +
            $"-master_pl_name master.m3u8 " +
            $"-hls_segment_filename \"{outputDirectory}/v%v/segment%d.ts\" " +
            $"\"{outputDirectory}/v%v/playlist.m3u8\"";

        await RunProcessAsync("ffmpeg", ffmpegArgs, cancellationToken);

        var duration = await GetDurationSecondsAsync(inputFilePath, cancellationToken);

        return new VideoConversionResult("master.m3u8", duration);
    }

    private static async Task<int> GetDurationSecondsAsync(string inputFilePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var args = $"-v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 \"{inputFilePath}\"";
        var output = await RunProcessAsync("ffprobe", args, cancellationToken, captureOutput: true);

        return double.TryParse(output.Trim(), out var seconds) ? (int)seconds : 0;
    }

    private static async Task<string> RunProcessAsync(string fileName, string arguments, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool captureOutput = false)
    {
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = fileName,
            Arguments = arguments,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true
        };

        using var process = Process.Start(psi)!;

        var stdOutTask = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();
        var stdErrTask = process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();

        await process.WaitForExitAsync(cancellationToken);

        var stdOut = await stdOutTask;
        var stdErr = await stdErrTask;

        if (process.ExitCode != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{fileName} failed: {stdErr}");

        return captureOutput ? stdOut : stdErr;
    }
}

FILE : \Handicraft.Infrastructure\Services\LocalVideoStorageService.cs
========================================================================================================================

using Handicraft.Application.Contracts.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace Handicraft.Application.Services
{
    public class LocalVideoStorageService : IVideoStorageService
    {
        private readonly string _basePath;

        public LocalVideoStorageService(IConfiguration config)
        {
            _basePath = config["VideoStorage:BasePath"] ?? "/data/videos";
        }

        public async Task<string> SaveRawVideoAsync(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, Stream fileStream, string fileName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var folder = Path.Combine(_basePath, courseId.ToString(), episodeId.ToString(), "raw");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);

            var rawPath = Path.Combine(folder, fileName);
            await using var fs = new FileStream(rawPath, FileMode.Create);
            await fileStream.CopyToAsync(fs, cancellationToken);

            return rawPath;
        }

        public string GetRawVideoPath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string fileName)
            => Path.Combine(_basePath, courseId.ToString(), episodeId.ToString(), "raw", fileName);

        public string GetHlsOutputDirectory(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId)
        {
            var folder = Path.Combine(_basePath, courseId.ToString(), episodeId.ToString(), "hls");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            return folder;
        }

        public string GetHlsPhysicalFilePath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId, string relativePath)
            => Path.Combine(GetHlsOutputDirectory(courseId, episodeId), relativePath);

        public string GetHlsPlaylistPath(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId)
            => Path.Combine(GetHlsOutputDirectory(courseId, episodeId), "master.m3u8");

        public Task DeleteEpisodeFilesAsync(Guid courseId, Guid episodeId)
        {
            var folder = Path.Combine(_basePath, courseId.ToString(), episodeId.ToString());
            if (Directory.Exists(folder))
                Directory.Delete(folder, recursive: true);

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}
